scope: Confirmed obsolete SMF functions and modes; exact legacy URL paths only. HTTP failures alone do not add entries.

entries.reason: SMF marks the MSN option quote function obsolete.
entries.replacement: Use a supported option source; positive Yahoo bid/ask prices still need verification.

entries.mode: OX, OX2, OX3 quotes; OX expirations/strikes
entries.reason: SMF records that optionsXpress is no longer a valid data source.
entries.replacement: Yahoo expiration/strike modes remain available; quote availability needs separate verification.

entries.reason: SMF explicitly marks the old ticker/quote-code CSV mode obsolete.
entries.replacement: Keep CSV-URL mode with empty pItems, or use the supported Yahoo JSON/history functions.

entries.reason: Yahoo retired query.yahooapis.com YQL on 2019-01-03, as recorded in the SMF change log.
entries.replacement: Use supported Yahoo JSON/history functions for the fields they provide.

entries.reason: The SMF option-strike manual explicitly labels the Google option source obsolete.
entries.replacement: Yahoo expiration/strike modes remain available; positive option prices need separate verification.

entries.reason: The SMF option-strike manual explicitly labels source 8 obsolete; these calls use that same legacy endpoint.
entries.replacement: Yahoo expiration/strike modes remain available; other iVolatility services are outside this guard.

numbered_fields.mode: Effective loaded definition, after metadata selectors and before evaluation
unsupported_literals: Obsolete -- Web site no longer exists
excluded_literals: Obsolete -- Now only available to premium subscribers
numbered_fields.custom_override: Inspect the current loaded recipe; never block by a historical field ID.
numbered_fields.definition_loading: Default local definitions require no network. User-selected Internet initialization remains separate and can fetch definition files before the field is known.
